summary: Comprehensive testing of AI Assistant chat input visibility bug fix. All 10 test scenarios passed on both desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844) viewports. The fix correctly addresses: (1) Input visible on initial panel open, (2) Compact mode: History button hides input, Back restores it, (3) Compact mode: Prompts button hides input, Back restores it, (4) Expanded mode: History button does NOT hide input (history shows in sidebar), (5) Expanded mode: Prompts button hides input, (6) Close and reopen panel resets state - input always visible, (7) Toggle History on/off restores input, (8) Input accepts text and send button enables, (9) Attach button visible, (10) Mobile viewport works correctly with dvh max-height.
critical_code_review_comments: Line 157 useEffect correctly resets showHistory/showPrompts to false when isOpen changes - fixes stale state on reopen
Line 487 isActiveChat condition correctly handles expanded mode: !showPrompts && (!showHistory || isExpanded) - input stays visible when history is in sidebar
Line 593 body div has min-h-0 class for proper flex overflow handling
Line 529 uses dvh (dynamic viewport height) for mobile viewport compatibility
Line 856 input area conditional render based on isActiveChat works correctly
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI Assistant chat input visibility bug fix fully tested. KEY FIX AREAS: (1) useEffect at line 157 resets showHistory/showPrompts on panel open. (2) isActiveChat condition at line 487 handles expanded mode correctly - input visible when history shows in sidebar. (3) min-h-0 on flex parent at line 593 for proper overflow. (4) dvh max-height at line 529 for mobile viewport. KEY DATA-TESTIDS: ai-assistant-fab, ai-assistant-panel, ai-message-input, ai-send-btn, ai-attach-btn, ai-history-btn, ai-prompts-btn, ai-back-btn, ai-expand-btn, ai-close-btn. Login flow: POST /api/auth/login with {email: 'testemployee@thriftycurator.com'} returns access_token, set in localStorage as 'token'.
